title: City Hall Auditorium Projector Replacement

onscreen_lines.desc: PROJECTOR Panasonic PT-MZ20K or acceptable alternate Alternate projectors must meet the minimum specifications below: Minimum of 20,000 Lumens Supports 4K/60 input (384x2160 @ 60Hz) WUXGA 1920x1200 Native Resolution minimum Minimum of one HDMI input AND one HDSDI input LAN port for projector networking Maximum output SPL of 45 dB or less Maximum dimensions of 28 in x 18 in x 8 in Maximum weigh of 60lbs
